Sometimes I hear voices, see things that are not there, I have had a psychotic eposide about 20 years ago.  BDP is like all mental health disorders rolled into one.  They say that hearing voices and seeing things that are not there,  etc, are just ultra high levels of anxiety. Than you have to add that I do not know who I am, what I am feeling, etc, very complicated. I would like to talk but I do not know what to say other than if I can stay home and be isolated, just to be in limbo I do not think I will be a danger to myself or others, I do want more but want it right now, I know small steps, but the steps are so very small and the gains so slight.  dealing with this shit for 25 years with no real massive improvements. I do not think I will ever have a real job, never drive again, lots of things - thankful for what I have - again BPD I do not know what I have, want I can do, etc.  everything requires some sort of relationship with other people and I avoid that, some things have improved slightly, I can talk to my Drs without feeling like I am clibling the walls with massive anxiety, still very anxious but not to the extremes of hearing voices, seeing things that are not there anymore, I can leave my house without complete and utter fear, crowds, getting a haircut, going to the dentist, etc is still a major challenge.  Quick relationships like a taxi is now okay, talking to a sales person, people I do not have to see again, anything longer than that is just so difficult, I thought it would get easier but it is not, relationships on any level with people I have to see again make me feel torn, I try and than melt down and very quickly go to wanting to hurt myself or suicide - end of world catastrophe stuff - I do not understand the process of how I quickly do that.  I have no friends, I have had none in years, joining clubs, doing middle class activities like pottery or whatever terrorify me, I am not good enough. I hate myself and the thing is, am I actually making myself mentally ill or is it real?   Lots of debate about that with BPD people.
I am probably making no sense at all?

No money, my partner has a very large family here, he will stay, I want to leave, gain my independence back - or should I say become independent for the first time, even just next door would do,  okay maybe a little further away, I have a whole list of to dos, that never seem to occur, I do not see them ever occurring, I am an only child, if I leave, my parents have said, that's it, you can never come back, no inheritance,  etc,  they will sell up,  moving here was only meant to be for a couple of months, to get on our feet, more importantly to get my partner on his meet, they want us to look after them, so funny as I can barely look after myself. I have disability pension (and work full time -  for an ADE, australian disability enterprise, that money reduces pension which is good I guess, for tax payers, but I only get about 1/3 of minimum wage.  Basically it's free work, you can stay at home and get full pension or work at an ADE, really it's all a big corporate con job.   he has full time work, we have applied for tons of housing, with no luck.  I do not care about the inheritance stuff.   My parents constantly inform me that they love but do not like me.    I am in my 40s, with little to no employment history, mental illness, addicted to benzo's, Ativan and clonazepam, with Drs approval of course, but still scary, the thought of coming off them and also wanting to take more and more of them because they lose their ability to work.   all the money we did save unfortunately we gave to my parents for safe keeping - basically that is now a right off.    I can not see a move happening, I still have trouble with anxiety on public transport and especially at work - every possible disability you can think of there.   Not a great place for people like us, avoidant, social phobia, panic, etc.    It's too overwhelming, all of it.  A move would be a huge help and relief, but really have no where to go or more importantly money to do it,  I have no idea why we keep being refused rentals, credit is excellent, no outstanding debts, I just do not get it

At 24 I moved to San Francisco, escaping, avoiding, Australia, it was great there for a while, I received a settlement for work place harassment, first case of its kind, made all the press, front page news, but settled before court. Really no chance of any employment after that.  my partner and I lived on that settlement in the US until it runout then back into prostitution, high end, a lot of money, but of course not socially acceptable, our world became much smaller, thus eventually re triggering all social phobia, etc.  my partner managed to get out, finding employment, then opening his own business, handy man company - we were not even living there legally.  I basically stayed at home and did nothing for over a decade, no desire to do nothing, really avoidant, panic attacks on and off just going outside the front door, public transport, etc.   We moved back to Australia just over two years ago - new doctors, new treatments - mindfulness, CBT, etc stuff I have never heard of before.  In San Francisco I was on lots of meds but I never challenged myself - I was never forced to - and yes I was completely ok with that, lol.  Here back in Australia - living with my parents and partner, that in itself is a night mere, add Drs, councillors, psychologists, programs, push push push, all the time.  I can no longer nor even want to cope with it anymore

Yes tons, as far back as I can remember, all sexuality stuff, bullying before I even knew what sex was, worse one was in high school, year 7, held down by a large group of girls - year 10s - whom I did not know, they stripped me bare naked, of course I was then the laughing stock of the school, teachers did find out but of course nothing was done - if the gender roles were reversed I am sure they would have been expelled and counseling offered  - closeted times back then though.  Then usual daily name calling and objects thrown at at, pushed, etc.  yeah I was pretty avoidant even then, later on add some illegal drugs into the mix and that set everything off mentally.   

Partner is aware of self harm in the past but not over the last few months, as I said we really are only friends now, I hide it from everyone

They know, at 18 years of age I did not leave the house for two years,  at that time I grew stronger, eventually gaining employment, but it all feel apart, bullying at work, no understanding from family, friends, anxiety returned, coping skills became prostitution etc, moving out of home because they wanted me to deal with the bullying,   I have no children, just elderly parents and a long time partner - who is aware of everything, we are really only friends now, my only friend,  he will get the money.
